## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## To reproduce

```ts
// minimal code snippet
import { SeekFleet } from "seekfleet";
// ...
```

or CLI:

```bash
npx seekfleet run "..."
```

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened. Include stderr / stack trace.

## Environment

- Node version: `node --version`
- OS:
- `npm ls seekfleet @deepseek-ai/dsh`
- `npx seekfleet --version`
- `npx seekfleet inspect`

## Additional context

Any other relevant info (logs, screenshots, links).
